seo.title: Modular Group — Walls, cabinetry, quartz and vanity tops
seo.description: One group, four manufacturers: Shower Walls, Modul Woods, Küartz Surfaces and Modular Vanity Tops. Complete bathroom and kitchen solutions for hospitality, multifamily, healthcare and residential projects.

hero.title: Four manufacturers. One standard.
hero.subtitle: Walls, cabinetry, quartz surfaces and vanity tops — engineered under one roof, delivered on one schedule.
hero.description: From a single hotel bathroom to a thousand-unit multifamily development, Modular Group supplies the whole room: waterproof wall systems, frameless cabinetry, quartz slabs and engineered vanity tops.

intro.title: One partner instead of four suppliers.
intro.description: Modular Group began in 2004 in Monterrey, Mexico with engineered vanity tops. Two decades later it manufactures wall panels, frameless cabinetry and the first quartz slabs made in Mexico — coordinated finishes, one point of contact, one delivery schedule.

companies.title: Each one a specialist. Together, the whole room.
companies.description: Every company keeps its own identity, plant and product line. Specify one or specify all four — the finishes are coordinated either way.

advantages.title: Built for projects that cannot afford surprises.

items.title: One coordinated scope
items.body: Walls, cabinets, countertops and vanity tops specified together, so tone, edge and finish actually match on site.

items.title: Manufacturing we control
items.body: Our own plants in Monterrey and Juárez, Nuevo León — not a catalog of other people's factories.

items.title: Repeatable at scale
items.body: Hundreds of identical units, produced to the same spec and delivered against a construction schedule.

items.title: Cross-border logistics
items.body: A distribution centre in Laredo, Texas keeps deliveries into the United States and Canada predictable.

seo.title: Shower Walls — High-performance shower wall panels and pans
seo.description: Shower wall panels, pans and accessories engineered for hospitality, multifamily, student housing and healthcare projects. Renovate without noise, dust or delays.

home.summary: High-performance shower wall panels, pans and accessories that replace tile — installed without the noise, dust and delays of traditional remodeling.
points: Hundreds of identical bathrooms, on schedule

hero.title: Built for the projects tile could not keep up with
hero.subtitle: High-performance shower wall panels, pans and accessories.
hero.description: Modern design, durability and innovation — a bathroom renovated without the noise, dust and delays of traditional remodeling.

about.title: Wall systems that behave like a product, not a trade.
body: At Shower Walls we manufacture high-performance shower wall panels, pans and accessories. We combine modern design, durability and innovation to renovate a bathroom without the noise, dust and delays of traditional remodeling.

Our systems were developed for hospitality, multifamily, student housing and healthcare operators who need hundreds of identical, flawless bathrooms delivered on a schedule — and for homeowners who want that same standard at home.

pillars.title: What we are here to do.

items.title: Our mission
items.body: To deliver modern, efficient alternatives to traditional tile, ensuring superior quality and seamless design on every unit we touch.

items.title: Our vision
items.body: To be the go-to brand for waterproof wall coverings in residential and commercial projects across North America.

advantages.title: Three things a tile crew cannot promise you.

items.title: No demolition noise
items.body: Panels go over the existing substrate, so occupied floors keep working while the bathroom is renewed.

items.title: No dust
items.body: No cutting, no mortar, no grout haze drifting through corridors and HVAC returns.

items.title: No delays
items.body: A manufactured system arrives complete and installs in a predictable window — the same window, unit after unit.

cta.title: Renovate the bathroom without closing the floor.
cta.description: Send us the unit count and the schedule — we will come back with a system and a timeline.

home.summary: Frameless cabinetry for bathrooms and kitchens — vanity cabinets, base and wall units, tall pantries, islands and custom storage, built in our own plant.

hero.title: Cabinetry built to match the room, not the catalog
hero.subtitle: Custom frameless cabinets for bathrooms and kitchens.
hero.description: The cabinetry division of Modular Group — vanity cabinets, base and wall units, tall pantries, islands and custom storage, manufactured in Monterrey, Mexico.

about.title: The beginning of Modul Woods.
body: Modular Vanity Tops was founded in 2004, specializing in the manufacturing of high-quality cultured marble vanity tops. Over the years, we expanded our product portfolio to include additional vanity top styles and materials, continually evolving to meet the needs of our customers.

In 2018, we launched Modul Woods, our custom cabinetry division, extending our expertise beyond countertops to include premium vanity and kitchen cabinets. Today, we manufacture frameless cabinetry for bathrooms and kitchens, offering vanity cabinets, base and wall cabinets, tall pantry units, islands, and custom storage solutions.

Our products serve residential, hospitality, multifamily, senior living, and commercial projects, providing customers with a complete, coordinated solution from a single manufacturing partner. Whether supplying a single home or a large-scale hotel or multifamily development, we are committed to delivering exceptional craftsmanship, dependable quality, and innovative designs that bring every space to life.

hero.title: Refresh your space with engineered stone

about.title: The first quartz slab factory in Mexico.
body: Founded in 2019, Küartz Surfaces joined the group and became the first and only quartz slab factory in Mexico. Located in Juárez, Nuevo León, our 75,348 ft² plant produces slabs, vanity tops, kitchen countertops, quartz walls and floors with specialized machinery.

hero.title: Since 2004, exporting fine engineered vanity tops
hero.subtitle: Manufactured in Monterrey. Distributed from Laredo, Texas.
hero.description: Fine quality engineered vanity tops for homes, hotels and motels, assisted living retirement centers and multi-family dwellings.

about.title: Since 2004, exporting fine engineered vanity tops.
body: Since 2004 we have been successfully exporting to the United States and Canada, distributing through Cultured Marble Manufacturers, Building & Plumbing Suppliers, General Contractors and Home Centers.

Our factory is located in Monterrey, MX, conveniently close to our Distribution Center, located in Laredo, Texas. We specialize in fine quality Engineered Vanity Tops, designed specifically for homes, hotels and motels, assisted living retirement centers and multi-family dwellings.
